# Offering Counter

> A free, mobile-first web app that helps church counting teams tally cash
> offerings by denomination, share a read-only summary via an expiring link
> (WhatsApp or any messaging app), and export the count as CSV.

## Key facts

- No user accounts, login, or sign-up required — fully anonymous.
- Supports counting cash by denomination for a given currency (INR at launch).
- Generates a share link valid for 30 days; the link and its data are then
  deleted automatically.
- Share links cannot be browsed or guessed — only someone with the exact
  link can view a count.
- Recipients can export the count as a CSV file directly from the share page.
- Free to use.

## Pages

- / — Landing page with product overview and FAQ.
- /count — The offering calculator.
- /faq — Full FAQ.
- /c/{shareId} — A private, time-limited read-only summary (not indexed).
